Rory (Support): @Maya urgent - tenant 'veridian-pay' in trial (5 seats) seeing SSO webhook failures + 401s. renewal touch in 4 days, ticket #82199 opened :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): copy. drop the latest error and who at Veridian we should loop in. we'll treat this as a CS priority handoff. :eyes:
Rory (Support): latest logs:
```
2024-09-12T10:02:13Z ERROR Auth: 401 Unauthorized - invalid_grant for client_id veridian-prod
2024-09-12T10:02:45Z WARN WebhookDelivery: 502 Bad Gateway -> retries 5
TraceID: trc-82199
```
Contact: leah@veridianpay.com (Head of Integrations). They've attempted the SSO setup twice and saw missing webhooks during a demo. ops-bot: traces -> https://int.redwood/logs/82199  metrics -> https://dash.redwood/tenant/veridian/82199
Maya (CS): triage plan 1) 10-15m warm intro with Leah today to confirm consent and scope 2) hands-on enablement tomorrow to regen credentials and validate webhook endpoint 3) short-term mitigation: disable retries and run manual backfill job. if backfill fails, escalate to eng-oncall. who can join enablement? :calendar:
Elena (Onboarding): I can run the walkthrough and update the onboarding checklist. available tomorrow 14:30 PT. I'll capture permission scoping steps.
Sam (Solutions): I'll prepare curl and Postman snippets, plus a quick rollback (switch to polling) if webhooks are unstable. can join 14:30 PT too.
Rory (Support): Leah available 3pm PT today for the quick sync. I'll attempt token regen after consent and post creds via vault link.
Maya (CS): i'll send the warm intro + calendar invites for both sessions, assign owners: @Elena / @Sam / @Rory. follow-ups: customer summary after enablement and renewal health status by Friday EOD. include trace links in the invites. closing loop unless anything else :thumbsup:
